aspects.says: The server's jPOS parts, such as the transaction manager and the multiplexer, are declared as Spring beans so the rest of the application can be given them.
aspects.reason: bean wiring with no behaviour of its own; what the transaction manager does is practised on the transaction-processing page

aspects.says: Q2 is the jPOS runtime, and a descriptor in its deploy directory makes it start a SpringContainer that loads the application's Spring context.
aspects.reason: configuration wiring that only shows itself in a running Q2 with a deploy directory; a graded run has no server to deploy into
